objective: Re-run the frozen native external-state proof against the full canonical-owner scope and append a distinct v1.0.3 verification receipt without claiming D064 closure.
non_goals: Do not claim BR4-D064 remediation or closure.

The recovery packet is VERIFICATION-only and may not edit product behavior; if it proves a product defect, this Program stops and any product fix requires a separately reviewed and user-approved successor.
Do not mutate W0-S3-INTEGRATION-001 or W0-S3-ATTEMPT-001 in place.
Do not migrate, rotate or delete the retained Keychain secret.
Do not expand into provider or product-data trials.
Do not change Rust, Tauri, React, commands, schemas, release bootstrap behavior, SecretStore behavior, MCP audit authority, or product data.
Do not treat native harness evidence as real Tauri desktop, external-provider, real-Keychain, durable-write, finding-closure, or Phase7 trial credit.
invariant: A fresh verification at one exact current SHA must reproduce both historical RED contracts and the positive native external-state evidence while crediting all three historical changed paths and all three frozen canonical-owner paths. It performs no product or authority mutation, never reads or changes the real OS Keychain or product data, preserves unsupported and unobserved surfaces as UNKNOWN, and stops the Program if a product defect is found.
minimal_fix_contract: No product fix is authorized. Verify the already-integrated native evidence owner and frozen canonical owners exactly as they exist at the execution baseline. If any command, RED, source fact, canonical-owner fact, or evidence dimension fails, return a bounded RED handoff and stop this Program for a separately reviewed and user-approved successor.
old_path_deletion_contract: No deletion or replacement is authorized in receipt recovery. Keep retired expected-absent product routes absent, preserve the invalid predecessor receipt and attempt byte-for-byte, and do not add a second SecretStore or external-state authority.
acceptance_criteria: The invalid predecessor receipt remains immutable and no-credit; a distinct current-SHA verification receipt covers every changed and canonical-owner path, passes independent review, and grants zero closure credit.

The packet is VERIFICATION-only, has a distinct task identity, and its frozen owner, allowlist, source map, forbidden paths, expected-absent paths, commands, dimensions, guards, and RED contracts exactly match the invalid predecessor packet.

Source evidence confirms that OPENLIFE_DATA_DIR selects filesystem state while the real Tauri entrypoint still selects StartupKeyringSecretStore; filesystem isolation alone therefore does not prove Keychain isolation.

The native harness uses the existing injected in-memory SecretStore seam and never calls the product bootstrap wrapper, KeyringSecretStore, StartupKeyringSecretStore, Settings credential paths, or the ignored real OS Keychain round-trip test.
The exact filtered Rust test and repository evidence runner pass without editing product code or tracked authority.
The positive record and both deliberate counterexamples remain distinguishable and fail closed for undeclared external state and for the false data-dir-equals-Keychain-isolation claim.

Evidence scope explicitly covers scripts/run-w0-s3-native-external-state-evidence.mjs, src-tauri/src/lib.rs, src-tauri/src/native_external_state_evidence.rs, openlife-core/src/mcp_audit.rs, src-tauri/src/bootstrap.rs, and src-tauri/src/secret_store.rs.
Unsupported, transient, global, unattributable, real-Tauri, real-Keychain, external-provider, and product-data surfaces remain UNKNOWN or NOT_CREDITED.
No credential value, real Keychain content, private product data, or unbounded log is captured.
BR4-D064 remains open with closure_credit=false and no Wave, feature, product-trial, or Phase7 completion credit is granted.
stop_conditions: Frozen source map or canonical owner is false.
A write is required outside allowed_touched_paths.
An expected-absent object would be recreated.
A required RED cannot be made to fail for the stated reason.
A closure-candidate proof has not failed before conditional implementation.
The same root cause has failed three implementation attempts.
The hard-stop size budget is exceeded; split the slice or stop for a successor Program.
External action or durable write needs authority not present in the packet.
The frozen allowlist, command, evidence dimension, guard, RED, or expected-absent contract differs from the invalid predecessor packet.
Any product, Program, ledger, validator, schema, command, frontend, release bootstrap, SecretStore, MCP audit authority, or product-data edit is required.
A verification command fails or the evidence runner cannot distinguish positive and counterfactual outcomes.
A real OS Keychain read, write, migration, rotation, enumeration, or delete would be required.
An external provider, non-loopback network, real durable write, or real product-data access would be required.
A credential value, real Keychain content, private product data, or unbounded log would enter an artifact.
A required surface is unsupported, incomplete, stale, or unattributable but would otherwise be reported as PASS instead of UNKNOWN.
Any result would be used to claim BR4-D064 closure, feature readiness, product-trial credit, or Phase7 completion.
ledger_update_contract: Only the Integrator may later append a distinct W0-S3 recovery attempt and integration receipt after same-head independent review. The old attempt, old receipt, adjudication, all 101 cards, BR4-D064 closure_credit=false, and all non-activation gates remain unchanged until that separate state commit.
handoff_contract: Return the exact baseline and verification head SHA, zero changed product paths, every command result, the positive native inventory, both historical RED outcomes, explicit six-path evidence scope, residual UNKNOWN/NOT_CREDITED surfaces, confirmation that real Keychain/product data/providers were untouched, and a same-head independent challenge.
